title: Validation of the German version of the "Stanford Gender-Related Variables for Health Research" (GVHR) questionnaire
summary:
In health research, the distinction between biological sex (Sex as a Biological Variable, SABV) and sociocultural gender (Gender as a Sociocultural Variable, GASV) is crucial. Gender factors (norms, roles, relationships) have been shown to influence health behaviors and outcomes. The “Stanford Gender-Related Variables for Health Research” (GVHR) questionnaire (Nielsen et al., 2021) is a newly developed, multidimensional instrument for the quantitative assessment of gender. The GVHR questionnaire has not yet been validated for German-speaking countries. 
The aim of the multicenter online project is therefore to reduce the gender data gap by validating the GVHR questionnaire for use in research and clinical practice. To this end, the GVHR questionnaire will be translated and psychometrically validated. Following a standardized translation process (forward-backward translation), the questionnaire will be presented to a sample of at least 500 people. To investigate the test-retest reliability, participants are asked to fill out the questionnaire a second time anonymously after three months, using a reminder they set themselves.

interventions.name: healthy subjects, assessment of the GVHR questionnaire, including a follow-up after three months
